newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern extends Conrail offer.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern extends Conrail offer.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp said it is extending its $110 cash tender offer for shares of Conrail Inc through January 10, 1997.

It also offered to formalize in a written agreement its pledge made earlier in the week that it would not participate in any agreement with CSX Corp or Conrail that delivered less than a $110 per share all-cash offer.
Conrail has rejected Norfolk Southern's $110 cash bid in favor of a cash and stock pact with CSX.
Norfolk Southern is urging Conrail shareholders to reject the proposed transaction with CSX.
